annotations.title: Ladder Arb Scanner — Kalshi spread/total ladders priced out of order (NFL · CFB · NBA · NHL · CBB · EPL · UCL)

description: Use for "is any NBA ladder mispriced tonight" and "where can I make a market on Kalshi". Kalshi spread/total strikes priced out of order across seven leagues — NFL, college football, NBA, NHL, men's college basketball, Premier League, Champions League: locked arbitrage, crossed-mid inversions on real two-sided books, and wide books worth making a market in, with both tickers and books, gross edge, volume and tier. Pro adds the resting orders, net-of-fee edge and quarter-Kelly size.

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, max 100; 3 when the call has no arguments).

min_edge.description: Minimum NET edge in cents (default 1). Accepts 2, "2c", "2".

min_volume.description: Minimum per-leg volume in dollars (default 20000). Accepts 20000, "$20,000".

sport.description: cfb · nfl · nba · nhl · cbb · epl · ucl · all (default all; both = all).
